title: A constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules embeds into a finite sum of finite pushforwards of constant sheaves
statement:
Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring and $F$ a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], an object of $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then there are an integer $n\ge0$ and, for $i=1,\dots,n$, a finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] morphism $f_i:Y_i\to X$ which is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] and a finite $\Lambda$-module $M_i$, and a monomorphism of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules
$$F\hookrightarrow\bigoplus_{i=1}^n f_{i,*}\underline{M_i}$$
into the finite direct sum (biproduct [def-weil-additive-category]) in $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$, where $\underline{M_i}$ is the constant sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules with value $M_i$ on $Y_{i,\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and $f_{i,*}$ the direct image of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. (Stacks states this for Noetherian $\Lambda$; a finite morphism is quasi-compact and separated, so 'finite and locally of finite presentation' is 'finite and of finite presentation'.)

source.place: Lemma 09Z7 (lemma-constructible-maps-into-constant-general), part (3), etale-cohomology.tex line 13028 (reference SGA 4, IX, Prop. 2.14)
